p.em: What are the deployable units and how do they communicate?

g.title: TypeScript / Next.js SSR — Ops dashboard, booking UI, seat map, check-in screens. Bilingual TH/EN via next-intl. Deployed on Vercel or GCP Cloud Run.
Golang — JWT validation, RBAC enforcement, rate limiting, request routing to downstream services. Single entry point for all API calls.
Java / Kotlin (Spring Boot) — PNR lifecycle, seat inventory state machine, fare rules, booking CRUD. Owns bookings + passengers tables.
Golang — Check-in session management, seat assignment, boarding pass PDF generation (IATA BCBP), gate manifest, offline cache. Owns checkins table.
Golang — Omise card charge, PromptPay QR generation, webhook handler, refund processing, daily reconciliation. Owns payments + transactions tables.
Java / Kotlin — Flight schedule CRUD, route configuration, aircraft seat map config, flight status management. Owns flights + routes + aircraft tables.
Golang — Staff account management, JWT issuance & validation, RBAC roles, audit log, session invalidation. Owns staff + audit_log tables.
Golang — Async email (SendGrid) and SMS (Twilio/True Move H) dispatch. Consumes events from Redis Streams. Owns notification_log table.
Primary relational database — bookings, passengers, payments, flights, staff, audit_log, checkins. AES-256 at rest. PITR enabled (5-min RPO).
In-memory store — JWT session cache, seat lock TTLs (8-min), check-in manifest cache (offline mode), Redis Streams for async notification events.
